caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, woven basket with a slightly bulging shape and a lid. The sides of the basket are bordered with a yellowish-brown wicker or straw-like material, and each visible side contains a panel with embroidered or painted floral designs. The panels are reddish-brown in color, and each features a large white and light pink flower with green leaves on a stem. The lid of the basket is darker, predominantly black or dark blue, and is decorated with leaf and flower motifs resembling those on the sides, though in more muted greens and darker tones. The texture of the weave and the patterns on the lid and side panels are carefully detailed, showing the structure and craftsmanship of the object. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or textures visible. There is a small handwritten inscription at the bottom right, which includes a name and the date "1930".
title: Birch Bark Sewing Basket
